description: Running ledger of verified discrepancies between Microsoft Learn docs, official Azure SDKs, and live Azure Storage wire behavior.

entries.summary: Live Azure returns unquoted ETag values inside <Etag> XML elements while HTTP ETag response headers are quoted.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Quoted ETag format matching HTTP ETag headers.
entries.observed_behavior: List Blobs XML emits unquoted <Etag> values (e.g. 0x8D...) whereas HTTP headers quote them.

entries.summary: Live Azure echoes the request continuation marker in paginated List Blobs XML responses.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Marker echo behavior is easy to omit from REST prose and was omitted in initial implementation.
entries.observed_behavior: Paginated List Blobs XML includes the echoed <Marker> element alongside <NextMarker>.

entries.summary: Sending both x-ms-range-get-content-md5 and x-ms-range-get-content-crc64 returns 400 BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent.
entries.observed_behavior: Live Azure returns 400 with error code BothCrc64AndMd5RangeHeaderPresent and a dedicated message.

entries.summary: 304 Not Modified responses include x-ms-error-code: ConditionNotMet with an empty body.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Plain 304 Not Modified without x-ms-error-code header.
entries.observed_behavior: Live Azure sets x-ms-error-code: ConditionNotMet on empty 304 conditional read responses.

entries.summary: Unpaged Get Page Ranges omits <NextMarker> from <PageList> XML.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Always emitting an empty <NextMarker /> element in <PageList>.
entries.observed_behavior: Live Azure omits <NextMarker> unless marker or maxresults is supplied on the request.

entries.summary: Unaligned byte ranges on Put Page return 400 InvalidHeaderValue rather than InvalidPageRange.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: 400 InvalidPageRange for ranges not aligned to 512-byte page boundaries.
entries.observed_behavior: Live Azure returns 400 InvalidHeaderValue ('The value for one of the HTTP headers is not in the correct format.').

entries.summary: Blob Delete on a non-empty HNS directory answers 409 DirectoryIsNotEmpty rather than DirectoryNotEmpty.
entries.observed_behavior: Live Azure answers 409 DirectoryIsNotEmpty ('This operation is not permitted on a non-empty directory.') on the Blob endpoint while DFS and Files keep their own codes.

entries.summary: Go Data Lake SDK sends /{account}/{filesystem}/{path} in x-ms-rename-source against path-style URLs.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: REST docs describe /{filesystem}/{path} without the account prefix.
entries.observed_behavior: Official Go Data Lake client includes the account segment in x-ms-rename-source for path-style endpoints.

entries.operation: Create Hard Link / Create Symbolic Link
entries.summary: Microsoft Learn NFS link pages disagree on x-ms-file-file-id vs x-ms-file-id; official SDKs read x-ms-file-id.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Some Learn REST pages list x-ms-file-file-id in response header tables.
entries.observed_behavior: Python azure-storage-file-share and other official SDKs parse x-ms-file-id.

entries.summary: Microsoft Learn titles the operation 'Read Symbolic Link' while other references call it 'Get Symbolic Link', and link routing uses restype= rather than comp=.
entries.expected_by_docs_or_sdk: Consistent operation naming across REST tables and manifests.
entries.observed_behavior: Learn REST API uses 'Read Symbolic Link' on GET ?restype=symboliclink.
